name: Satvik Vishwanath
headline: Exploring finance, entrepreneurship and venture capital.
about: I am a first-year Bachelor of Business Administration student at T. A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), Bengaluru, part of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). My interests lie in finance, entrepreneurship, and venture capital. I am at the beginning of my academic and professional journey, and I am using coursework and projects to build a stronger understanding of business fundamentals, financial thinking, and the challenges of building and scaling ventures. While having interests in finance, I also have a keen interest in Sports. I have been the Sports captain of my school in grades 11 and 12, while I also played Volleyball and Badminton on a professional level.

projects.title: Ashneer Grover: rebranding and rhetorical analysis
projects.description: Decoded the rhetoric behind Ashneer Grover’s public persona, then rebuilt his brand from what we found.

projects.title: ChaiNest Cafes: clean, combine and visualise a year of sales
projects.description: Turned a messy sales export into a clean 600-order dataset (Rs 4,73,725 revenue) in Power Query, then built a three-page Power BI report on sales, products and store targets. Result: 5 of 10 stores hit their 2025 target.

projects.title: Financial Analysis of Britannia PVT Ltd
projects.description: A close reading of Britannia’s financial statements, putting core accounting concepts to work on a real company.

projects.title: Mathematics in Cafe
projects.description: We invented a cafe, Brew Heaven, and used graphs and maths to show how a business grows and performs.

projects.title: AI and the future of work
projects.description: How AI is reshaping gig work, seen from three sides: we interviewed app users, delivery partners and partner restaurants of Swiggy and Zomato.

projects.title: CaterAI - AI Agent
